mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (<=0.1%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the central bank's accommodative stance supports equity valuations through low discount rates and liquidity provision.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of all periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 235.0 signals accelerating inflation, which triggers central bank tightening and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: The co-occurrence of a persistently low federal funds rate (<=0.1%) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235.0) signals an impending monetary policy tightening, which increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% AND CPIAUCSL > 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by quarterly GDP growth > 1.0% and unemployment rate < 5.0%), a rise in the Consumer Price Index above 235.0 signals overheating and triggers central bank intervention, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 235.0 AND GDPC1 growth > 1.0% AND UNRATE < 5.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.0 AND GDPC1 growth > 1.0% AND UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST > 1000.0) signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO > 100.5) signals strong manufacturing activity and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.5.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 6.0%) signals a tight labor market and strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS > 427000.0) signals strong consumer demand and economic resilience, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 427000.0.
